cases.description: Virgo BidCo Pty Ltd (BidCo), an affiliate of certain funds advised and/or managed by affiliates of Blackstone Inc. (Blackstone), proposes to acquire HSBC Bank Australia Limited’s (HBAU) portfolio of Australian home and personal loans (the Acquisition). BidCo intends to direct that title in these loans be transferred at completion to Perpetual Corporate Trust Limited (Perpetual) in its capacity as trustee of three securitisation trusts. Perpetual will appoint Pepper Money Limited under contractual servicing arrangements to undertake the operational management and administration of the loans. Certain home loans originated by HBAU are held within four existing securitisation trusts – the Lion Series 2020-1 Trust, Lion Series 2022 1 Trust, Lion Series 2023-1 Trust and Lion Series 2024-1 Trust (together, the Lion Trusts). As part of the Acquisition, BidCo will nominate ABF Whole Loan Pty Ltd (an affiliate of certain funds advised and/or managed by affiliates of Blackstone, and BidCo’s parent) to acquire the sole participation unit and 9 of the 10 residual units in each of the Lion Trusts. Perpetual CT Capital Pty Ltd (a Perpetual Group entity) will acquire 1 of the 10 residual units in each of these trusts. Blackstone is a US-based investment management firm. Perpetual is a Sydney-based trust company and a wholly-owned subsidiary within the Perpetual group of companies (Perpetual Group), of which Perpetual Limited is the ultimate parent company. HBAU is the Australian-owned subsidiary of HSBC Holdings plc (including its affiliates, HSBC). HBAU currently offers a range of financial services in Australia, including retail banking, private banking, asset management and corporate and institutional banking. HSBC has announced it intends to exit its retail banking operations in Australia.

As part of its service offering in Australia, WSP supplies a range of geotechnical testing and interpretation services (geotechnical testing services) to customers for onshore projects. Geotechnical testing services involve testing samples from various sources and environments and interpreting the test results to support geotechnical engineering analysis and related work. WSP operates five accredited geotechnical testing laboratories in Australia (located in Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide and Olympic Dam). GTI supplies a range of geotechnical testing services in Australia to customers for both onshore and offshore projects, with a focus on providing offshore marine testing services. GTI operates one geotechnical testing laboratory in Australia (located in Perth).

cases.title: INNIO Group – Enerflex
cases.description: INNIO Holding GmbH (INNIO Holding), through its wholly owned subsidiaries INNIO Jenbacher International B.V. (INNIO Jenbacher International) and INNIO Jenbacher Netherlands B.V. (INNIO Jenbacher Netherlands) (together with their affiliates, the INNIO Group) proposes to acquire 100% of the share capital in Enerflex Service Pty Limited (Enerflex). The Target Companies provide aftermarket services (spare parts, repair and maintenance) for gas compression and energy infrastructure. (the Acquisition). INNIO Group is a global manufacturer of gas power units under the Jenbacher and Waukesha brands. INNIO Group manufactures gas power units and genuine spare parts at its facilities (primarily in Austria for Jenbacher and the United States, and Canada for Waukesha) and supplies these globally through distributors, including in Australia. Enerflex Australia is an aftermarket services provider for energy infrastructure operators in Australia. It provides maintenance, repair, replacement of spare parts, field services, retrofits, and the supply of gas power units (new and refurbished as replacements) as part of their aftermarket services for a wide variety of gas compression and power generation units and other related equipment, such as compressor units and electric motors.
